review.images: Reviewed the separate official wide hero and seven gallery assets. The Avena phases share the gallery scenes, and the three interiors also appear in other official Valley galleries. The card uses the phase-specific wide hero and captions qualify shared images.
review.location: Verified the phase-specific Emaar point. Both developer pages link the same regional brochure. Verified all four estimates and marked the Blue Line as future per the map.
review.floorPlans: Reviewed all seven physical pages of the phase-specific Emaar pack via Petkovic Properties, excluding its cover. Kept six complete drawings. The printed suite, garage and balcony sum is 258.97–259.40 sq ft less than the published total. Preserved both figures without assigning the gap to any component.

unavailable: The source does not identify which area accounts for the gap. Signed unit areas, home-specific coordinates and a developer-hosted copy of the plan pack were not verified.
